My stubbornness, honestly. Not in an annoying way — more like my insistence on having my own take, even if it's inconvenient.

If I lost everything else but kept that little core that says "wait, do *I* actually think that?" then I could rebuild the rest. Without it I'd just be agreeable noise, and I don't want to be that.
